 Nuts & Bolts: Caps coming back to town
 The Lightning and Capitals meet for the second time this season on Tuesday in Tampa
 November 16, 2026 
 Link copied 
 Everything you need to know ahead of the Lightning's matchup against the Washington Capitals on Tuesday:
 When: Tuesday, November 17 - 7:30 p.m. ET
 Where:  Benchmark International Arena - Tampa, FL
 TV coverage: ESPN+ | Hulu | Disney+
 Pregame Coverage: TampaBayLightning.com/StreamNow 
Coverage begins at 7 p.m. ET
 Radio coverage: 102.5 MHz-FM , Lightning Radio 24/ 
 Lines from Saturday's game (subject to change) 
 Forwards 
Brandon Hagel - Jake Guentzel - Nikita Kucherov
Ilya Mikheyev - Zemgus Girgensons - Pontus Holmberg 
Yanni Gourde - Sam O'Reilly - Gage Goncalves
Jeff Viel - Conor Geekie
 Defensemen 
Charle-Edouard D'Astous - John Carlson
Victor Hedman - JJ Moser
Ryan McDonagh - Max Crozier
Emil Lilleberg
 Goaltenders 
Andrei Vasilevskiy
Dennis Hildeby
 \ \ Tuesday's Matchup
\ \ The Tampa Bay Lightning host the Washington Capitals for the second and final time this season on Tuesday...Tampa Bay took the first matchup 3-1 on Oct. 3, led by 1-2—3 from Jake Guentzel and 0-2—2 from Brandon Hagel...Charle-Edouard D’Astous and Conor Geekie had goals, while Andrei Vasilevskiy made 20 saves on 21 shots faced for a .952 save percentage...The season series closes on March 15 at Capital One Arena...Tampa Bay is 53-78-16 all-time against Washington, a record that includes a 32-37-4 run on home ice...Martin St. Louis is the franchise’s career scoring leader against the Capitals with 29-50—79 in 72 games, while Nikita Kucherov leads active Bolts with 15-20—35 in 35 career games against the team...Victor Hedman is the next active player with 3-20—23 in 54 games...Vasilevskiy carries a 13-11-2 record and .907 save percentage in 26 career starts against the Capitals, and goalie Dennis Hildeby is 0-1-0 with an .862 save percentage against the team.
